example_sentences.de: Das Einwohnermeldeamt hat nur vormittags geöffnet.
example_sentences.en: The residents' registration office is only open in the mornings.

example_sentences.de: Ich habe einen Termin beim Einwohnermeldeamt.
example_sentences.en: I have an appointment at the residents' registration office.

cloze.de: Ohne Wohnungsgeberbestätigung nimmt das ___ die Anmeldung nicht an.
cloze.en: Without the landlord's confirmation, the registration office will not accept the registration.

words.notes: Older official name for the office most cities now call Bürgeramt or Bürgerbüro. All three words mean the same counter.
words.mnemonic: Einwohner (resident) + melden (report) + Amt (office).
words.germany_context: Where you do your Anmeldung after moving. Termine are scarce: many cities release cancelled slots early in the morning, so checking the booking page around 7 a.m. is a well-known trick. Bring your passport, the Wohnungsgeberbestätigung and the filled-in form.

example_sentences.de: Das Jobcenter hat meinen Antrag bekommen.
example_sentences.en: The job centre has received my application.

example_sentences.de: Sie geht morgen zum Jobcenter.
example_sentences.en: She is going to the job centre tomorrow.

cloze.de: Wer Bürgergeld bekommt, hat einen festen Ansprechpartner beim ___.
cloze.en: Anyone receiving basic income support has a fixed contact person at the job centre.

words.notes: Neuter and pronounced as in English, but it is the official German name of the authority.
words.mnemonic: Das Center → neuter, like das Zentrum.
words.germany_context: The Jobcenter pays Bürgergeld and places long-term unemployed people. It is not the same as the Agentur für Arbeit, which handles Arbeitslosengeld I for people who paid into unemployment insurance.

example_sentences.de: Das Jugendamt hilft Familien mit Kindern.
example_sentences.en: The youth welfare office helps families with children.

example_sentences.de: Wir haben einen Brief vom Jugendamt bekommen.
example_sentences.en: We received a letter from the youth welfare office.

cloze.de: Beim ___ kann man die Vaterschaft anerkennen lassen.
cloze.en: At the youth welfare office you can have paternity officially acknowledged.

words.mnemonic: Jugend (youth) + Amt (office).
words.germany_context: Unmarried fathers acknowledge paternity (Vaterschaftsanerkennung) here, free of charge, ideally before the birth. The Jugendamt also arranges child maintenance and, in some cities, Kita places.

example_sentences.de: Das Sozialamt zahlt die Grundsicherung.
example_sentences.en: The social welfare office pays the basic support benefit.

example_sentences.de: Er hat beim Sozialamt einen Antrag gestellt.
example_sentences.en: He filed an application at the social welfare office.

cloze.de: Rentner mit wenig Geld bekommen Hilfe vom ___.
cloze.en: Pensioners with little money get help from the social welfare office.

words.germany_context: Responsible for people who cannot work: pensioners on Grundsicherung, care costs, help for disabled people. People who are able to work go to the Jobcenter instead.

example_sentences.de: Das Ordnungsamt kontrolliert die Parkplätze.
example_sentences.en: The public order office checks the parking spaces.

example_sentences.de: Der Nachbar hat das Ordnungsamt gerufen.
example_sentences.en: The neighbour called the public order office.

cloze.de: Wegen des Lärms hat sich jemand beim ___ beschwert.
cloze.en: Because of the noise, someone complained to the public order office.

words.mnemonic: Ordnung (order) + Amt: the office that keeps order.
words.germany_context: Handles parking fines, noise complaints, dog registration, Sperrmüll appointments and street permits. Its officers wear uniforms and can issue on-the-spot fines, but they are not the police.

example_sentences.de: Wir bekommen Kindergeld für zwei Kinder.
example_sentences.en: We receive child benefit for two children.

example_sentences.de: Das Kindergeld kommt jeden Monat aufs Konto.
example_sentences.en: The child benefit arrives in the account every month.

cloze.de: Den Antrag auf ___ stellt man bei der Familienkasse.
cloze.en: You file the application for child benefit at the family benefits office.

words.notes: No plural: it is an amount of money, like das Geld.
words.mnemonic: Kind + Geld: money for the child.
words.germany_context: Paid monthly per child regardless of income, until 18 and up to 25 while the child is studying. You apply in writing at the Familienkasse of the Agentur für Arbeit with the child's Geburtsurkunde and Steuer-ID; foreign birth certificates usually need a beglaubigte Übersetzung.

example_sentences.de: Nach der Geburt haben wir Elterngeld beantragt.
example_sentences.en: After the birth we applied for parental allowance.

example_sentences.de: Das Elterngeld ersetzt einen Teil des Gehalts.
example_sentences.en: The parental allowance replaces part of the salary.

cloze.de: Mein Mann nimmt zwei Monate ___ und bleibt zu Hause.
cloze.en: My husband is taking two months of parental allowance and staying at home.

words.mnemonic: Eltern + Geld: money for the parents.
words.germany_context: Roughly 65 percent of your previous net pay for 12 to 14 months, applied for at the Elterngeldstelle. The form is long, is normally submitted on paper with payslips attached, and processing takes many weeks, so apply immediately after the birth.

example_sentences.de: Sie bekommt Wohngeld, weil die Miete zu hoch ist.
example_sentences.en: She receives housing benefit because the rent is too high.

example_sentences.de: Wohngeld muss man jedes Jahr neu beantragen.
example_sentences.en: Housing benefit has to be applied for again every year.

cloze.de: Wer wenig verdient, kann ___ bei der Stadt beantragen.
cloze.en: People with a low income can apply for housing benefit at the city.

words.mnemonic: Wohnen + Geld: money towards living costs.
words.germany_context: A rent subsidy for low earners who do not receive Bürgergeld. Applied for at the Wohngeldstelle of your Stadt or Landkreis; you need the Mietvertrag, income proof and usually your Mietbescheinigung signed by the landlord.

example_sentences.de: Er bekommt seit einem Jahr Bürgergeld.
example_sentences.en: He has been receiving basic income support for a year.

example_sentences.de: Das Bürgergeld deckt auch die Miete.
example_sentences.en: The basic income support also covers the rent.

cloze.de: Das Jobcenter zahlt das ___ am Monatsanfang.
cloze.en: The job centre pays the basic income support at the beginning of the month.

words.mnemonic: Bürger (citizen) + Geld.
words.germany_context: Replaced Hartz IV in 2023. Paid by the Jobcenter to people able to work who have no or too little income; it includes reasonable rent and health insurance contributions.

example_sentences.de: Nach fünf Jahren kann man die Niederlassungserlaubnis beantragen.
example_sentences.en: After five years you can apply for the permanent residence permit.

example_sentences.de: Mit der Niederlassungserlaubnis darf man unbefristet bleiben.
example_sentences.en: With a permanent residence permit you may stay indefinitely.

cloze.de: Für die ___ braucht man Deutschkenntnisse und Rentenbeiträge.
cloze.en: For the permanent residence permit you need German skills and pension contributions.

words.notes: Compounds ending in -erlaubnis are feminine, like die Erlaubnis.
words.mnemonic: die Erlaubnis → die Niederlassungserlaubnis.
words.germany_context: Unlimited residence title, normally after 5 years of legal residence with 60 months of pension contributions and B1 German. Blue Card holders can apply after 33 months, or 21 months with B1, which is why the Blaue Karte EU is popular with IT workers.

example_sentences.de: Als Ingenieurin hat sie die Blaue Karte EU bekommen.
example_sentences.en: As an engineer she received the EU Blue Card.

example_sentences.de: Die Blaue Karte EU gilt zuerst für vier Jahre.
example_sentences.en: The EU Blue Card is initially valid for four years.

cloze.de: Mit einem guten Gehalt bekommt man als Informatiker schnell die ___.
cloze.en: With a good salary, computer scientists get the EU Blue Card quickly.

words.notes: Fixed official name, so the adjective Blaue stays capitalised.
words.mnemonic: die Karte → die Blaue Karte EU.
words.germany_context: Residence title for graduates with a job offer above a salary threshold; the threshold is lower for shortage occupations such as IT. It gives faster access to a Niederlassungserlaubnis and easier family reunification than a normal work permit.

example_sentences.de: Ohne Arbeitserlaubnis darf er hier nicht arbeiten.
example_sentences.en: Without a work permit he is not allowed to work here.

example_sentences.de: Die Arbeitserlaubnis steht im Aufenthaltstitel.
example_sentences.en: The work permission is stated in the residence title.

cloze.de: Die Ausländerbehörde hat mir die ___ erteilt.
cloze.en: The immigration office granted me the work permit.

words.mnemonic: die Erlaubnis is feminine, so all -erlaubnis compounds are too.
words.germany_context: There is no separate card any more: the permission is printed on your residence permit, for example 'Erwerbstätigkeit gestattet' or a restriction to one employer. Read that line before signing a new Arbeitsvertrag.

example_sentences.de: Er denkt über die Einbürgerung nach.
example_sentences.en: He is thinking about naturalisation.

example_sentences.de: Die Einbürgerung dauert oft über ein Jahr.
example_sentences.en: Naturalisation often takes more than a year.

cloze.de: Für die ___ braucht man mindestens Sprachniveau B1.
cloze.en: For naturalisation you need at least language level B1.

words.notes: From ein + Bürger: literally 'making someone a citizen'.
words.mnemonic: Nouns in -ung are always feminine.
words.germany_context: Since 2024 possible after 5 years of residence (3 with strong integration), with B1 German, the Einbürgerungstest, a clean record and no reliance on state benefits. Dual citizenship is now allowed, so Turkish citizens no longer have to give up their passport.

example_sentences.de: Welche Staatsangehörigkeit haben Sie?
example_sentences.en: What nationality do you have?

example_sentences.de: Sie hat die türkische und die deutsche Staatsangehörigkeit.
example_sentences.en: She has Turkish and German nationality.

cloze.de: Im Formular muss man die ___ eintragen.
cloze.en: You have to enter your nationality on the form.

words.notes: Standard field on almost every German form. Staatsbürgerschaft means the same thing.
words.mnemonic: Nouns in -keit are feminine.
words.germany_context: Forms ask for Staatsangehörigkeit, not Herkunft. Write the country adjective in the neuter form, for example 'türkisch', which is what the officials expect.

example_sentences.de: Ich habe den Einbürgerungstest bestanden.
example_sentences.en: I passed the citizenship test.

example_sentences.de: Der Einbürgerungstest kostet 25 Euro.
example_sentences.en: The citizenship test costs 25 euros.

cloze.de: Für den ___ muss man 33 Fragen beantworten.
cloze.en: For the citizenship test you have to answer 33 questions.

words.mnemonic: der Test → der Einbürgerungstest.
words.germany_context: 33 multiple-choice questions drawn from a public pool of 310 on law, history and society; 17 correct answers are enough. You book it at a Volkshochschule and can practise the whole pool for free online.

example_sentences.de: Die Geburtsurkunde braucht eine Apostille.
example_sentences.en: The birth certificate needs an apostille.

example_sentences.de: Ohne Apostille erkennt das Amt das Dokument nicht an.
example_sentences.en: Without an apostille the office does not recognise the document.

cloze.de: Meine Heiratsurkunde habe ich mit ___ aus der Türkei mitgebracht.
cloze.en: I brought my marriage certificate from Turkey with an apostille.

words.mnemonic: Sounds French and ends in -e: feminine.
words.germany_context: German offices accept foreign civil-status documents only with an apostille from the issuing country plus a beglaubigte Übersetzung by a sworn translator. Get apostilles while you are still in your home country; obtaining one afterwards means a trip back or a consulate procedure.

example_sentences.de: Der Notar liest den Kaufvertrag laut vor.
example_sentences.en: The notary reads the purchase contract out loud.

example_sentences.de: Wir haben einen Termin beim Notar.
example_sentences.en: We have an appointment at the notary's office.

cloze.de: Ohne ___ kann man in Deutschland keine Wohnung kaufen.
cloze.en: In Germany you cannot buy a flat without a notary.

words.notes: Female form: die Notarin.
words.germany_context: Notaries have a legal monopoly on property purchases, company formations and certain powers of attorney, and must read the whole contract aloud. Their fees are set by law, so comparing prices does not help.

example_sentences.de: Ich gebe meiner Frau eine Vollmacht.
example_sentences.en: I am giving my wife a power of attorney.

example_sentences.de: Mit einer Vollmacht kann jemand anderes für dich unterschreiben.
example_sentences.en: With a power of attorney somebody else can sign for you.

cloze.de: Bring bitte die ___ und deinen Ausweis mit.
cloze.en: Please bring the written authorisation and your ID card.

words.notes: The formal verb is erteilen: eine Vollmacht erteilen.
words.mnemonic: die Macht (power) → die Vollmacht.
words.germany_context: A short handwritten Vollmacht is often enough to let a friend collect a document or attend an appointment for you, but most Ämter only accept it together with a copy of the authoriser's Personalausweis.

example_sentences.de: Gegen den Bescheid kann man Widerspruch einlegen.
example_sentences.en: You can file a formal objection against the decision.

example_sentences.de: Mein Widerspruch war erfolgreich.
example_sentences.en: My objection was successful.

cloze.de: Sie haben einen Monat Zeit, um ___ einzulegen.
cloze.en: You have one month to file an objection.

words.notes: The fixed phrase is Widerspruch einlegen, not 'machen'.
words.mnemonic: der Spruch → der Widerspruch: speaking against something.
words.germany_context: Every Bescheid ends with a Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung stating the deadline, normally one month from delivery. Send the Widerspruch in writing, quote the Aktenzeichen, and use Einschreiben so you can prove it arrived in time.

example_sentences.de: Ich habe eine Beschwerde geschrieben.
example_sentences.en: I wrote a complaint.

example_sentences.de: Die Beschwerde liegt jetzt beim Amtsleiter.
example_sentences.en: The complaint is now with the head of the office.

cloze.de: Wenn nichts passiert, hilft nur noch eine schriftliche ___.
cloze.en: If nothing happens, only a written complaint will help.

words.notes: In the plural, Beschwerden also means medical symptoms: Ich habe Beschwerden im Rücken.
words.mnemonic: From sich beschweren (to complain).
words.germany_context: A Beschwerde is an informal complaint about how you were treated; a Widerspruch is the formal legal objection to a decision. If a Sachbearbeiter refuses something you believe you are entitled to, ask politely for the decision in writing first.

example_sentences.de: Bitte bringen Sie einen Nachweis über Ihr Einkommen mit.
example_sentences.en: Please bring proof of your income.

example_sentences.de: Als Nachweis reicht eine Kopie des Mietvertrags.
example_sentences.en: A copy of the rental contract is sufficient as proof.

cloze.de: Ohne ___ über die Krankenversicherung geht gar nichts.
cloze.en: Without proof of health insurance nothing works at all.

words.notes: Very productive in compounds: Einkommensnachweis, Versicherungsnachweis, Sprachnachweis.
words.mnemonic: nachweisen = to prove; der Beweis and der Nachweis are both masculine.
words.germany_context: German offices work on paper proof, not on statements. Bring originals plus copies of everything on the list, because a missing Nachweis usually means the whole appointment has to be repeated.

example_sentences.de: Ohne Ihre Einwilligung dürfen wir die Daten nicht weitergeben.
example_sentences.en: Without your consent we may not pass on the data.

example_sentences.de: Die Eltern haben ihre Einwilligung gegeben.
example_sentences.en: The parents gave their consent.

cloze.de: Bitte unterschreiben Sie hier die ___ zur Datenverarbeitung.
cloze.en: Please sign the consent to data processing here.

words.mnemonic: einwilligen = to agree; -ung makes it feminine.
words.germany_context: You sign Einwilligungen constantly: at the doctor, at the Kita, at work. They can be withdrawn in writing at any time, and offices must tell you what the data is used for.

example_sentences.de: Der Datenschutz ist in Deutschland streng.
example_sentences.en: Data protection is strict in Germany.

example_sentences.de: Aus Gründen des Datenschutzes geben wir am Telefon keine Auskunft.
example_sentences.en: For data protection reasons we do not give information over the phone.

cloze.de: Wegen des ___ darf die Behörde nichts per E-Mail schicken.
cloze.en: Because of data protection the authority may not send anything by email.

words.notes: Genitive adds -es: des Datenschutzes.
words.mnemonic: der Schutz (protection) → der Datenschutz.
words.germany_context: Germany applies the GDPR strictly, which is why authorities refuse to discuss your file by phone or email and insist on paper post. Expect a Datenschutzerklärung to sign at every doctor, school and employer.

example_sentences.de: Mein Sachbearbeiter heißt Herr Weber.
example_sentences.en: My caseworker is called Mr Weber.

example_sentences.de: Der Sachbearbeiter sitzt in Zimmer 214.
example_sentences.en: The caseworker sits in room 214.

cloze.de: Rufen Sie bitte Ihren zuständigen ___ an.
cloze.en: Please call the caseworker responsible for you.

words.notes: Female form: die Sachbearbeiterin. Plural is the same as the singular for the masculine form.
words.mnemonic: Sache (matter) + bearbeiten (to process): the person who processes your matter.
words.germany_context: Your file belongs to one named person whose name, room number and Durchwahl appear on every Bescheid. They have real discretion, so being polite, prepared and punctual with a specific Sachbearbeiter usually achieves more than emails to the general address.

example_sentences.de: Die Wartezeit beträgt zwei Stunden.
example_sentences.en: The waiting time is two hours.

example_sentences.de: Mit einem Termin ist die Wartezeit kürzer.
example_sentences.en: With an appointment the waiting time is shorter.

cloze.de: Beim Bürgeramt muss man mit einer langen ___ rechnen.
cloze.en: At the citizens' office you have to expect a long wait.

words.mnemonic: die Zeit → die Wartezeit.
words.germany_context: Waiting weeks or months for a Termin is normal. Cancelled slots are released overnight, so refreshing the booking page around 7 a.m. often finds one; smaller Stadtteil offices and neighbouring towns are usually far quicker than the Hauptstelle.

example_sentences.de: Der Besuch ist nur nach Terminvereinbarung möglich.
example_sentences.en: A visit is only possible by appointment.

example_sentences.de: Die Terminvereinbarung läuft über die Webseite der Stadt.
example_sentences.en: Appointment booking is done via the city's website.

cloze.de: An der Tür steht: Zutritt nur mit ___.
cloze.en: It says on the door: entry only with an appointment.

words.mnemonic: Termin + vereinbaren + -ung.
words.germany_context: 'Nur nach Terminvereinbarung' is on almost every office door since 2020; open walk-in hours have largely disappeared. Book online, print the confirmation, and arrive on time, because being ten minutes late usually voids the slot.

example_sentences.de: Für den Antrag brauche ich ein neues Passfoto.
example_sentences.en: I need a new passport photo for the application.

example_sentences.de: Das Passfoto muss biometrisch sein.
example_sentences.en: The passport photo has to be biometric.

cloze.de: Im Drogeriemarkt kann man ein ___ machen lassen.
cloze.en: You can have a passport photo taken at the drugstore.

words.mnemonic: das Foto → das Passfoto.
words.germany_context: Biometric rules are strict: 35 x 45 mm, face filling most of the frame, neutral expression, mouth closed, plain light background, no reflections on glasses. Since 2024 the photo for a Personalausweis or Reisepass must reach the Amt digitally, either taken in the office terminal or sent by a photographer.

example_sentences.de: In Deutschland gibt es eine Meldepflicht.
example_sentences.en: In Germany there is a legal duty to register your address.

example_sentences.de: Die Meldepflicht gilt auch für Studenten.
example_sentences.en: The duty to register also applies to students.

cloze.de: Wer die ___ nicht beachtet, muss ein Bußgeld zahlen.
cloze.en: Anyone who ignores the duty to register has to pay a fine.

words.mnemonic: die Pflicht (duty) → die Meldepflicht.
words.germany_context: You must register your address within two weeks of moving in and re-register after every move. Fines of up to 1000 euro are possible, and without a Meldebescheinigung you cannot get a bank account, Steuer-ID or residence permit.

example_sentences.de: Bitte geben Sie bei Rückfragen das Aktenzeichen an.
example_sentences.en: Please quote the file reference number if you have questions.

example_sentences.de: Das Aktenzeichen steht oben links auf dem Brief.
example_sentences.en: The file reference number is at the top left of the letter.

cloze.de: Ohne ___ findet die Behörde meinen Antrag nicht.
cloze.en: Without the file reference number the authority cannot find my application.

words.notes: Nouns ending in -chen are always neuter.
words.mnemonic: die Akte (file) + das Zeichen (sign) → das Aktenzeichen.
words.germany_context: Every letter from an Amt carries one. Put it in the subject line of any reply, on every document you hand in and in the email, otherwise your paper can sit unassigned for weeks.

example_sentences.de: Ich schicke die Kündigung per Einschreiben.
example_sentences.en: I am sending the termination letter by registered post.

example_sentences.de: Das Einschreiben ist gestern angekommen.
example_sentences.en: The registered letter arrived yesterday.

cloze.de: Wichtige Briefe an Behörden schickt man besser als ___.
cloze.en: It is better to send important letters to authorities by recorded delivery.

words.notes: A nominalised verb, so it is neuter. The fixed phrase is per Einschreiben.
words.mnemonic: Nominalised infinitives are always neuter: das Essen, das Einschreiben.
words.germany_context: Sent at any Deutsche Post branch. Use Einschreiben mit Rückschein for a Kündigung, a Widerspruch or anything with a Frist, because the signed receipt proves the exact date it was delivered.

example_sentences.de: Sie bekommen eine Bestätigung per Post.
example_sentences.en: You will receive a confirmation by post.

example_sentences.de: Ich habe noch keine Bestätigung bekommen.
example_sentences.en: I have not received a confirmation yet.

cloze.de: Als ___ hat mir das Amt eine E-Mail geschickt.
cloze.en: The office sent me an email as confirmation.

words.notes: From bestätigen (to confirm). Nouns in -ung are feminine.
words.germany_context: Print every online Bestätigung and keep it. German offices treat the paper copy as the real proof, and appointment confirmations often have to be shown at the entrance.

example_sentences.de: Das neue Gesetz gilt ab Januar.
example_sentences.en: The new law applies from January.

example_sentences.de: Nach dem Gesetz muss man sich anmelden.
example_sentences.en: According to the law you have to register.

cloze.de: Rauchen ist in Restaurants per ___ verboten.
cloze.en: Smoking in restaurants is prohibited by law.

words.notes: das Gesetz = the written law; das Recht = the law as a system or a right.
words.mnemonic: Ge- nouns are usually neuter: das Gebäude, das Geschäft, das Gesetz.
words.germany_context: Officials constantly cite the paragraph they are applying, for example 'nach Paragraf 17 Bundesmeldegesetz'. Asking which law a refusal is based on is normal and often makes the decision clearer.

example_sentences.de: Am Schalter bekommen Sie Auskunft.
example_sentences.en: You can get information at the counter.

example_sentences.de: Die Behörde gibt am Telefon keine Auskunft.
example_sentences.en: The authority does not give information over the phone.

cloze.de: Können Sie mir eine kurze ___ geben?
cloze.en: Could you give me a short piece of information?

words.notes: The fixed verb is Auskunft geben or Auskunft erteilen, not 'machen'.
words.mnemonic: die Ankunft, die Zukunft, die Auskunft: all -kunft nouns are feminine.
words.germany_context: In an Amt or a Bahnhof, the desk labelled Auskunft is the first stop. Note that authorities often refuse to give Auskunft by phone for data-protection reasons and insist that you come in person or write.

example_sentences.de: Ich muss meinen Aufenthaltstitel verlängern.
example_sentences.en: I have to extend my residence permit.

example_sentences.de: Die Behörde hat das Visum um ein Jahr verlängert.
example_sentences.en: The authority extended the visa by one year.

cloze.de: Wann lässt du deinen Pass ___?
cloze.en: When are you having your passport renewed?

words.notes: Inseparable ver- prefix, so the participle has no ge-: verlängert.
words.mnemonic: lang → länger → verlängern: to make longer.
words.germany_context: Apply to extend a residence permit six to eight weeks before it expires. If the Ausländerbehörde cannot decide in time it issues a Fiktionsbescheinigung, which keeps your status legal while you wait.

example_sentences.de: Sie müssen persönlich beim Amt vorsprechen.
example_sentences.en: You have to appear in person at the office.

example_sentences.de: Er hat gestern bei der Ausländerbehörde vorgesprochen.
example_sentences.en: He appeared in person at the immigration office yesterday.

cloze.de: Bitte ___ Sie mit allen Unterlagen am Donnerstag vor.
cloze.en: Please come in person with all your documents on Thursday.

words.notes: Separable, with the irregular stem change e → i: du sprichst vor.
words.mnemonic: vor (before) + sprechen: to speak before an official.
words.germany_context: 'Bitte sprechen Sie persönlich vor' on a letter means you must show up yourself, not send an email. The list of documents to bring is usually on the second page, and arriving without one of them means a new Termin.

example_sentences.de: Ich habe alle Unterlagen eingereicht.
example_sentences.en: I have submitted all the documents.

example_sentences.de: Den Antrag können Sie online einreichen.
example_sentences.en: You can submit the application online.

cloze.de: Bis Freitag muss ich die Steuererklärung ___.
cloze.en: I have to submit the tax return by Friday.

words.notes: More formal than abgeben; the standard word on official forms.
words.mnemonic: ein + reichen (to hand): to hand something in.
words.germany_context: Even where an online form exists, many authorities want the printed and signed version by post afterwards. Keep a copy of everything you einreichen, together with the Einschreiben receipt.

example_sentences.de: Die fehlenden Dokumente können Sie nachreichen.
example_sentences.en: You can submit the missing documents later.

example_sentences.de: Ich habe die Kopie später nachgereicht.
example_sentences.en: I submitted the copy later.

cloze.de: Den Nachweis über das Einkommen reiche ich morgen ___.
cloze.en: I will submit the proof of income tomorrow.

words.notes: Used constantly in the phrase fehlende Unterlagen nachreichen.
words.mnemonic: nach (after) + reichen: to hand in afterwards.
words.germany_context: A very common outcome: the office accepts your Antrag but asks you to nachreichen missing papers within a stated Frist. Miss that deadline and the application is often rejected outright, so send them by Einschreiben.

example_sentences.de: Das Amt kann die Kopie beglaubigen.
example_sentences.en: The office can certify the copy.

example_sentences.de: Meine Zeugnisse wurden beim Bürgeramt beglaubigt.
example_sentences.en: My certificates were certified at the citizens' office.

cloze.de: Lassen Sie die Übersetzung bitte ___.
cloze.en: Please have the translation certified.

words.notes: Inseparable be- prefix, so no ge- in the participle: beglaubigt.
words.mnemonic: be- + glauben: to make something believable, officially.
words.germany_context: Beglaubigte Kopien are made at the Bürgeramt for a few euros; take the original and the copy with you. Foreign diplomas and certificates additionally need a beglaubigte Übersetzung by a court-sworn translator (vereidigter Übersetzer) before any Amt will accept them.
